title: Add JWT auth
description:
## What
Issue a short-lived JWT on login and verify it on protected routes.

## Done when
- POST /login returns a signed JWT for valid credentials.
- Protected routes reject missing/expired tokens with 401.
- Refresh token is rotated on every use.

## Notes for future agents
Access tokens are 15m; refresh tokens live in the `sessions` table and are rotated on use. Signing secret comes from `JWT_SECRET` (never hardcode it). If you touch auth, update `tests/test_auth.py` — it locks in the 15m expiry.

review_log.comment: expiry is 24h, make it 15m and add a refresh endpoint
